definitions.gloss: to submit, to present, to turn in, to file
definitions.explanation: To formally hand in or present documents, reports, applications, or other materials to an authority, organization, or instructor.

examples.japanese: レポートを{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{書類|しょるい}は{明日|あした}までに{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}の{書類|しょるい}を{税務署|ぜいむしょ}に{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I submitted the tax return documents to the tax office.

notes:
One of the most essential formal verbs for students, office workers, and anyone dealing with bureaucracy. Used constantly in school, work, and government contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {提出|ていしゅつ}{期限|きげん}: submission deadline
- {提出|ていしゅつ}{書類|しょるい}: documents to be submitted
- {提出|ていしゅつ}{先|さき}: place of submission
- {提出|ていしゅつ}{物|ぶつ}: submitted items, homework/assignments
- {法案|ほうあん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a bill (legislation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出|だ}す: to turn in, to hand in — casual, everyday equivalent
- {提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit — formal, used in official and academic contexts
- {申請|しんせい}する: to apply for — specifically for requesting permission or a license
